mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! Imagine being able to look back on a hundred years of living—seeing how the ordinary moments and the truly unforgettable ones blend together, shaping a lifetime of wisdom and joy. That’s exactly the journey we get to explore together, thanks to the incredible life of Jean Dolores Schmidt, or as so many lovingly call her, Sister Jean, in her book, Wake Up With Purpose!: What I’ve Learned in My First Hundred Years. What makes Sister Jean’s story so special? It’s the way she faces change and challenge with a heart full of optimism, faith, and kindness. Her life is a beautiful mix of service, community, and perseverance—qualities that have seen her through decades of ups and downs. As we dive into her memories, we’ll wander from the lively hum of school corridors to the high-energy buzz of basketball courts. Sister Jean’s days have been filled with connection, mentorship, and those small but meaningful joys that make each morning worth waking up for. Through her gentle reflections, we’ll find lessons on how to meet adversity with grace—and maybe even a little humor. Her journey is a tapestry woven with faith, growth, and the kind of caring that changes lives. Every story, every insight, feels like a gentle reminder to hold onto hope, practice gratitude, and, above all, live with purpose. So, as we set off together, let’s get curious about what really matters, and discover how embracing each day with intention can bring new meaning—no matter what season of life we’re in.
